{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders with 999999.99 revenue
qa_mask = df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
refunded_count = refunded_mask.sum()

# Check for -1 in customer_age
age_neg1_mask = df['customer_age'] == -1
age_neg1_count = age_neg1_mask.sum()

# Print summary
print(f"QA orders (revenue_numeric = 999999.99): {qa_count}")
print(f"Refunded orders: {refunded_count}")
print(f"customer_age == -1: {age_neg1_count}")

# Show the first few rows of the parsed revenue
print("\nFirst 5 parsed revenue values:", df['revenue_numeric'].head().tolist())"}
